statement: With theta=21/40 and the same Baker--Harman--Pintz short-prime-interval input used by van Doorn--Tang, for all sufficiently large k and every integer n with 2k<n<=exp((log k)^2/(16 log log k)), the product (n-k)...(n-1) has a prime divisor p in (k,2k). Consequently n_k>exp((log k)^2/(16 log log k)).
